A store with lots of pet supplies, recommended, good prices

Kiwoko at Campo Pequeno is undoubtedly one of the best stores for pet owners. The staff is always extremely friendly, attentive, and available to help, whether it's finding the right product or giving useful care tips. The store is well-organized, has a wide variety of pet food, toys, and accessories, and the prices are very competitive. Furthermore, I love the fact that they offer services like bathing and grooming, always with great professionalism. I highly recommend it; it's a place where both we and our furry friends are always welcome!
Amazing store, welcoming atmosphere, friendly and always smiling staff, it's always my first choice when I need to buy something for my animals.
The best store I go to for buying treats for my cat; they always have everything I'm looking for, and the service is exceptional.
